summary.zh: 继续修复登出链路：登出时强制重建导航图并重置回登录页，不再依赖弹栈行为；附诊断提示。
summary.en: Continued sign-out fix: the nav graph is force-rebuilt on sign-out so the back stack resets to the login page; diagnostic toasts included.

items.zh: 登出时导航图强制重建，返回登录页不再依赖返回栈弹栈
items.en: Sign-out force-rebuilds the nav graph, guaranteeing return to login without relying on stack popping

items.zh: 诊断构建：包含临时屏幕提示以定位剩余问题（正式版移除）
